$comment: AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/gen-icon-index.mjs. Every icon in XUI, searchable by meaning. Read by the find_xui_icon MCP tool and scripts/find-icon.mjs. Do not edit by hand.

v2.label: Icons v2
v2.note: The primary set. Four tones (outlined/solid/dualtone/dualtone-selected), renders in currentColor, follows the theme. Reach for these first.

general.label: General icons
general.note: The Figma "Icon Library". Single-tone, currentColor, follows the theme. Use when Icons v2 has no equivalent.

trade.label: Trade type icons
trade.note: The six trade-type glyphs. Same components as the general icons, grouped because Figma groups them.

coin.label: Coin icons
coin.note: Transaction-type BADGES, not general-purpose icons. Fixed raw-hex palette that does NOT follow the theme; they take `size` but ignore `color`.
